**Reachability:** External 
**Exploitability:** Trivial 
**CWE:** [CWE-502](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/502.html) — Deserialization of Untrusted Data

**Do not unpickle request-supplied backups.**

A caller who can submit a backup controls the bytes passed to `pickle.loads`. A crafted pickle can execute arbitrary code with the archive process's permissions. Base64 decoding does not make those bytes safe. `IngestSnapshot.model_validate` runs after code execution can occur. Python explicitly warns against unpickling untrusted data. ([docs.python.org](https://docs.python.org/3.13/library/pickle.html?utm_source=openai))

Use a safe serialization format at this endpoint. Convert legacy backups through a separate, isolated migration process rather than unpickling them in the API.
